summary.text: Richard Grayson is the Green Party candidate for the Arizona House of Representatives, District 7, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An author, college professor and attorney, he advanced from the Green Party primary on July 21, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Grayson was born in Brooklyn, New York, and graduated from Midwood High School in 1968.

He earned a bachelor's degree from Brooklyn College in 1973, a master's degree from the College of Staten Island in 1975, a second master's degree from Brooklyn College in 1976, and a law degree from the University of Florida Levin College of Law in 1994.
His career includes work as a writer, college professor, law school administrator and staff attorney.
Grayson has run for a number of offices in several states, including the 2026 U.S. Senate race in Alaska, in which he lost in the August 18 primary.
